anchors.description: Full height of the white-framed glazed double-leaf entrance door at the main entrance, from the top of the door head frame down to the bottom sill/threshold line.
anchors.visible_evidence: The white door head frame, the two glass leaves and the bottom sill of the main entrance are all visible and sharp; head-frame top corner and bottom-frame corner lie on the same leaf plane and are unobstructed.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Modern full-glass double entrance doors in Swiss institutional buildings are typically ~2.4-3.0 m tall by leaf proportions (leaves clearly taller-than-standard, roughly 1:3 width-to-height), so the exact module height is uncertain within that range.

anchors.description: Diameter of the round no-parking prohibition sign (blue field, red rim, red diagonal bar) mounted on the left concrete column.
anchors.visible_evidence: The circular red-rimmed sign with diagonal bar is fully visible on the concrete column face; both left and right rims are distinguishable as two separate surface points.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: It is a private-property sign for which 25-40 cm diameters are sold; a standard 40/60 cm road-sign size would be inconsistent with its small apparent size relative to the nearby door, so exact diameter stays uncertain.
